correctness.rationale: Independent Fano point/line incidence p·q=0 on nonzero F2^3 generated exactly 21 flags and pairwise induced-compatible complex f_{-1..2}=(1,21,84,84), no 3-dimensional faces. With actual 20-edge spanning-tree certificate, independently verified connected acyclic tree and 64 successive triangle/remaining-one-cell collapses exhausting 84 one-cells, leaving twenty 2-cells and no 1-cells. This constitutes a homotopy CW cancellation, not merely field homology. Independently enumerated 336 distinct GL3(F2) collineation+duality automorphisms, their signed face Lefschetz traces {20:1,-4:21,2:56,0:210,-1:48}, including 168 duality coset with trace 0; the mean is 0. This supports wedge^20 S2 and full rational character, no G-fixed H2.
residual_risks: No integral representation decomposition or equivariant homotopy type was shown.
